item.title: Re: LSDeath
item.content:encoded:
Follow-up critique coming up.

Hmm… the story sounds interesting enough. With an MK ultra storyline, I'd try and convey how much abuse was actually faced by the test subject - which, don't get me wrong, your idea is already doing. But - at least in my opinion, it would be more interesting if the anomalous effects where a feature rather than a bug. If your gonna do a reality-warping thing, maybe the tablets cause reality to appear to warp in a way that makes people with the tablets to act in the interests of the project (e.g being unable to perceive or comprehend that the American government could do anything wrong). Perhaps the only reason why this failed was the creature appearing in every batch they made, and they can't explain it. But that's just spitballing.

I think you should stick to this idea, but, if you haven't, read some articles from series 6 and the how to write an SCP guide to get your bearings on what will be successful on the site.

Good Luck!

item.title: Re: LSDeath
item.content:encoded:
Returned for followup crit; PM Request

Hmmmm it's definitely getting there, but it feels like the previous idea with a loosely tacked-on MK-Ultra plot point and for some reason, they just happen to think, 'hey, what about throwing our black belt martial artist D-class in there?'

There's also a matter of how you're going to present this in an article, so think on that as well.

I think I've done everything I can to offer advice. There's a fine line to be crossed that borders between giving guidance and straight up trying to turn someone else's idea into my own vision, and I do everything I can to avoid the latter. So, I've crit your idea twice and now I'll ask you to seek out other reviewers in the butterfly squad roster. They're really good and really insightful reviewers on this page. Getting more perspectives on this idea is definitely my recommendation as of now.

You're definitely getting there, though, so don't give up!

If I were to offer some last minute suggestions before I head out, though…your sub reality part interests me more than the killer humanoid. There are endless killer humanoids out there. Do we really need another? That's not me dismissing this idea, mind you. Just challenging it.

Anywho, I hope I helped further and I bid you a good day. 👍

item.title: Re: LSDeath
item.content:encoded:
Heyo, I'll take a look for you.
Hmmmm I like the idea of an anomalous tab of LSD that lets you physically interact with hallucinations, but so far, this is a basic and slightly different form of 'Thing that kills you.'

Not much narrative happens aside from the monster killing you once you start tripping. It reminds me heavily of SCP-513, in fact. However, even if something has already been done to death, it's what you do with it that can make it fresh all over again.

Even the blandest of anomalies (your anomaly kinda is, but is still usable) can be made interesting with a decent enough story. Like, this is lsd. It's a drug. Maybe a drug dealer made it to try to get back at someone? Just spitballing an idea here.

It doesn't even have to be a monster. You have a psychedelic drug (btw real life LSD doesn't make you hallucinate big scary things; you have really fast thoughts and, at most, see some pretty, swirling colors. But this is an SCP, so you can get away with it here.) that can let you interact with actual existing things. You can get a lot more creative than just a scary monster.

Anywho, I hope I helped and I bid you a lovely day. 👍👍👍

item.title: LSDeath
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Page Layout: Special containment procedures on top, description in the middle, and addendum at the bottom

Elevator Pitch: There is a sheet of acid that exists that can make people hallucinate a whole new reality with a creature that will attack and kill them without mercy.
.
Central Narrative: When the participants of MKUltra were given tabs from this sheet they all began to overdose but when effects of a brutal assault started showing up on their bodies the foundation was asked to investigate. Using D-class personal to test the tabs ended up in several failures but eventually, one survived. when asked about the drug's effects he stated that reality warped around him, The sky began to change color, the ground began to make wave patterns, and there were red pine trees that walked on goat hooves. One thing in the hallucination did attack him though, it was a purple-skinned humanoid creature with a spherical head who appeared to be euphoric with dark burn-like marks on its body. This creature was determined to be what caused the strange deaths of the MKUltra participants and the sheet of LSD was confiscated by the foundation

Hook/Attention Grabber: This sheet of acid was a major reason that Project MKUltra was shut down but due to its anomalous nature it was confiscated by the foundation and the patient's deaths were covered up. Nobody but the person being attacked is able to see the monster, when the monster kills its victim all anybody can tell is that they died of an overdose but after a certain amount of time the effects of its grueling attack will be shown.

Additional notes: Should I stick with this Idea or abandon it for a new one I want this to be a success
